label: sec:archimedean-hartree-crystal-alpha-em-categorical-preamble
html: The upstream Mathlib additions catalogue the categorical structures underlying the substrate-flow construction. The trace ratio identity determines the substrate-flow value from the \alpha_{\mathrm{EM}} categorical-trace ratio. The multiplicative-chain shift and q-chromaticity blocks specify the substrate-flow behaviour of \alpha_{\mathrm{EM}} at the substrate parameter q_0.
